summaryZh: Knight 实验室研究不同生态系统中生物分子、基因组与群落组成的演化，包括人体复杂微生物生态系统。实验室开发并使用计算与实验技术，并公开软件、协议及数据，以支持微生物生态学研究。
researchQuestions: 生物分子、基因组和群落组成如何在不同生态系统中演化？

evidence.quote: The Knight Lab uses and develops state-of-the-art computational and experimental techniques to ask fundamental questions about the evolution of the composition of biomolecules, genomes, and communities in different ecosystems, including the complex microbial ecosystems of the human body.
providing free, open-source software tools and making all protocols and data publicly available
Knight Lab - University of California San Diego
